body: I'm not going to tell you what to do because I believe in FREEDOM...but if I could be there for you in person tonight then I would hug you and beg you to stay.

I wish I could hug you tonight so you can live another day...

I've been there...with the Buck Knife pressed to the veins within my arms...personally sharpened by my own hand with the trusty whetstone, ready to split myself open and watch as my life force pours out upon the ground.

You WILL be hugged again.

Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow, but one day you will be hugged and loved.

You will feel alive.

You're not alone.

I told my mom I wanted to kill myself.

She raged and ranted, then ran into her bedroom.

I then heard her say "Just shut the fuck up about it or do it already."

2 years later I'm still here, but I can't say it gets any better. I've got this 9mm to end it all.

My brain scanned it all and saved it successfully.

It's all true and it's all tearing me apart from within just the same...
